description:
On July 15th,2022 Houston-based producer Sines releases his EP All Things Heal, mapping a constellation of rhythms and movement across reggaeton, amapiano, and batida type beats. The 4-track EP applies a lighter touch to dance floor music right on time for summer months, underscoring Sines’ heartfelt embrace of change and trust in the process of transformation.


The EP sets off with the namesake track “All Things Heal,” channeling kuduro percussion, reversed vocals, and roving melodies for a buoyant opener. “Say Nothing Riddim” drops in with a spacious, looming amapiano cadence, hovering over chopped vocal samples and a driving bassline. “Key 2 Mine” transmits the airy essence of Tainy-referencing reggaeton beats, announcing itself with sultry MIDI synth chants. Club underground legends Florentino and DJ Python step up for a breezy remix of “Say Nothing,” driving the BPM up a notch for a trance-inducing peak set moment. 


The record, dropping on Sines’ Amor imprint as a sub-label of his MAJÍA record label, showcases the patience and perseverance through metamorphosis that is a hallmark of Sines’ trajectory as an artist and label head. All Things Heal was produced in Sines’ home studio outside of Houston, Texas, and was engineered by Cristo Gavras, also known as Imaabs.


Raised and rooted in South Texas, DJ and producer Sines is an integral part of the evolution of US-based, Latinx club music’s growth and mutation. Integrating undeniable influences from the borderlands’ natural cross-hatching of sounds, Sines’ productions are based in knowledge that’s equal parts inspired by Luny Tunes’ groundbreaking sample palette that forms the roots of reggaetón, as much as by the dripping, cathartic pace Houston’s legendary chopped and screwed pioneer DJ Screw. "All Things Heal" will be available on the Majia bandcamp and all digital streaming retailers.
